title: Framing Dryness Verification before Closing Walls, Reconstruction Change Orders
content:
Before a drywall or insulation line on a Reconstruction change order closes walls over framing a water loss reached, the dryness of that framing is verified when the preceding company water job stopped drying early. The verification is a fixed item of the change order, read from the Water Damage Mitigation job recorded on the contract as its preceding mitigation job: that job's drying outcome, its water class and its tier's fees.

**Verification item.**

- Where that water job's drying outcome is customer release and its water class is class 3 or class 4: the water job tier's moisture mapping fee plus its thermal imaging fee.
- Where its drying outcome is customer release and its water class is class 1 or class 2: the water job tier's moisture mapping fee.
- Every other line carries no verification item.

## Combinations

| Line | Preceding water job's drying outcome | Water class | Verification item |
|---|---|---|---|
| drywall or insulation | customer release | class 3 or class 4 | moisture mapping fee plus thermal imaging fee |
| drywall or insulation | customer release | class 1 or class 2 | moisture mapping fee |
| drywall or insulation | any outcome other than customer release | any | none |
| drywall or insulation | no preceding water job | — | none |
| any other line | any | any | none |

The item is one amount per change order, whatever the quantity written.

## Example (hypothetical fees)

A water job released early by the customer at class 3, on a water tier whose moisture mapping fee is assumed at $140.00 and thermal imaging fee at $110.00, gives a drywall change order a verification item of $250.00; at class 2 the item would be $140.00.
